text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer can identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in one image. Computer vision has many useful applications in daily life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to detect other vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic signs. It also helps doctors examine medical images and allows phones to unlock using your face. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more important in our world.
